note: Use conjugation action. For x outside Z(G), stabilizer C_G(x) is proper; by Lagrange its order is p^m with m<n, so orbit size [G:C_G(x)]=p^(n-m) is divisible by p. The class equation then gives p | |Z(G)|. Since the identity is central and |Z(G)| is a positive multiple of p, |Z(G)|>=p and contains a nonidentity element.
